evidence.quote: Jeff Dean announced Discovery Loop with Sanjay Ghemawat, Oriol Vinyals and Quoc Le.

story_beats.answer: Discovery Loop was announced by Jeff Dean with Sanjay Ghemawat, Oriol Vinyals and Quoc Le.
The stated first focus is automating machine-learning experimental loops.
The announcement describes a direction and initial focus; it does not establish a mature released product.
